title_sq: Apartament 4+1+2 per shitje prane rruges Myslym Shyri
description_sq:
SHume prane rruges MYSLYM SHYRI shesim apartament 4+1+2T me siperfaqe 164 m2 bruto dhe 150 m2 neto . Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e pare banim te nje ndertimi me 4 kate pa ashensor. Secili kat banohet nga nje familje .
Apartamenti ka orientimin Jug dhe Veri dhe mund te sherbeje si banim ose dhe per ambjent biznesi si psh zyra ,klinika etj. Gjithashtu vlen te permendet qe planimetria e apartamentit eshte lehtesisht e ndashme ne 2 apartamente te bollshme .
Perbehet nga :
Hyrja ne nje koridor te bollshem qe ben shperndarjen ne te gjitha ambjentet .
Salloni i bollshem dhe me orientim nga jugu ben qe te kete ndricim te bollshem gjate dites.
Kuzhine per gatim dhe hapsire e bolleshme per ngrenien e vakteve .
3 dhoma gjumi . 2 prej dhomave jane me orientim nga jugu dhe dhoma tjeter nga veriu se bashku me nje ballkon te bollshem .
Ka 2 tualete njeri i rinovuar totalisht dhe me pajisje cilesore. tualeti tjeter ka nje paradhome dhe ka ndricim natyral.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor .
Ju lutem shikoni videon dhe planimetrine e apartamentit.
Per me shume informacion ju lutemi me kontaktoni !
title_en: Apartment 4+1+2 for sale near Myslym Shyri street
description_en: Very close to MYSLYM SHYRI street, we are selling a 4+1+2T apartment with an area of ​​164 m2 gross and 150 m2 net. The apartment is located on the first residential floor of a 4-story building without an elevator. Each floor is inhabited by a family. The apartment has a South and North orientation and can be used as a residence or for a business environment such as an office, clinic, etc. It is also worth mentioning that the floor plan of the apartment is easily divided into 2 spacious apartments. It consists of: Entrance to a spacious corridor that distributes to all areas. The spacious and south-facing living room provides plenty of light during the day. Kitchen for cooking and ample space for eating meals. 3 bedrooms. 2 of the rooms are facing south and the other room is facing north along with a spacious balcony. There are 2 bathrooms, completely renovated and with quality equipment. the other toilet has an anteroom and has natural lighting. Has regular mortgage documentation. Please see the video and floor plan of the apartment. For more information, please contact me!
